About this dashboard

RecallAR turns John’s people, memories, and everyday objects into gentle, personalized activities on his phone. This dashboard shows what he did today.

Everything here is descriptive, not diagnostic: completed activities, hints used, and questions asked — never a clinical assessment.

This is a hackathon prototype using seeded demo data. No real patient data is stored.
